summary: Join our Personalized Customer Service Training in tourism. Gain essential skills to provide outstanding service and create memorable experiences for guests.
lede: Personalized customer service in tourism helps professionals move beyond routine transactions and create interactions that make guests feel seen, heard, and understood. This course shows you how to recognize individual needs, adapt your communication, and tailor service across online, phone, and face-to-face conversations. You will practise using observations and simple data to personalize recommendations, respond to different personalities and cultures, and recover effectively when service goes wrong. Designed for tourism professionals in varied roles, the course connects thoughtful guest experiences with operational, occupancy, and revenue goals.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for tourism and hospitality professionals who regularly interact with guests and influence their experience.
audience: Front office and reception staff in hotels
Guest relations, concierge, and butler service teams
Travel agents and tour consultants in agencies
Reservations and customer support teams (phone, email
Airline and transport customer service representatives
Restaurant and F&B service staff in tourism
Destination management and visitor information center staff
modules: The New Tourism Guest and Experience Economy
Reading Guests: Profiles, Preferences, and Personas
Digital Tools and CRM for Tourism Personalization
Cultural Intelligence and Diversity in Guest Service
Handling Complaints and Service Recovery with a Personal Touch
Designing Memorable Moments and Added Value
Measuring Service Quality and Using Guest Feedback
Building a Guest-Centric Culture in Tourism Organizations
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 1 year of experience in a customer-facing role within the tourism or hospitality industry. Basic understanding of customer service principles is recommended.
